notes.title: [OUTLAWED] Update Announcement on March 27th
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are about to update the game. This update aims to enhance the gaming experience and fix known issues. 

The specific update details are as follows:

[h3][b]Update Content:[/b][/h3]


[list]
[*] A new tactical item - Flashbang is added.
[*] A new skin, Salome, is added.
[*] A new type of backpack - Baby Bottle is added.
[*] Now, high-level treasure chests or rare items will spawn on the final evacuation helicopter.
[*] In the PVE mode, the stats of some AI characters and bosses have been reduced.
[*] When certain cheating behaviors are detected, players will be kicked out of the game.
[*] The price of high-level armor has been adjusted.
[*] Several bugs have been fixed. 
[/list]


If you encounter any problems after the update, please feedback in a timely manner through the official game community or customer service channels, and we will solve them for you as soon as possible.

Thank you for your support and love for the game. We hope this update will bring you a more wonderful gaming experience!

notes.title: PVE SOLO&COOP MODE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Calling all mercenaries! [/b]OUTLAWED’s highly requested PVE Mode is coming soon! Dive into a gang-ruled metropolis and carve your path through chaos—solo or with 2 allies—without the threat of rival players. This standalone mode offers a fresh progression system (separate from PVEVP) and relentless action!

[h3]🆕 New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] PVE Mode – Face thrilling challenges and put your survival skills to the test.
[*] New Battle Rifle: AR-15 – A powerful addition to your arsenal.
[*] 3 New Backpacks & 3 New Skins – Customize your loadout with fresh designs.
[*] New Boss: The Otherworldly Legion – A fearsome new enemy has arrived!
[/list]

[h3]⚙️ Improvements & Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Key rooms & Boss locations are now displayed on the map for better navigation.
[*] Safe spawn rates increased – More opportunities to secure valuable loot.
[*] Backpacks will remain in the scene even if players disconnect.
[*] Boss loot will no longer disappear automatically.
[*] Evacuation points will now appear 6 minutes into the match, with only 2 initial exits for a more balanced experience.
[*] Solo Mode Adjustment: Players can no longer call for help or form teams.
[*] AI Behavior Improved – No more being pushed off ladders!
[/list]

[h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where AI could attack players underground.
[*] Backpacks now drop correctly when players die mid-air.
[*] Fixed a bug where some AI could walk through walls.
[*] Resolved a physics issue with airdrops landing on vehicles.
[*] Fixed an issue where Golden Hepburn would not spawn properly.
[/list]

If you encounter any problems after the update, please feedback in a timely manner through the official game community and customer service channels. We will solve them for you as soon as possible.

Thank you for your support and love for the game. We hope this update can bring you a more wonderful gaming experience!

notes.title: OUTLAWED IS NOW LIVE ON STEAM!
notes.content:
TO ALL PLAYERS,

After a long period of meticulous development and polishing, OUTLAWED is officially available on Steam! Enjoy a 10% limited-time launch discount for the first two weeks (March 13–27)!

One-time purchase, lifetime ownership – Expand your secure storage through gameplay, unlock all character skins by defeating bosses or redeeming in-game currency, and receive free future updates including new zones, weapons, gear, gameplay modes, and bosses. No paywalls, no tiers – all content is equally accessible to every player.


[b]TACTICAL COMBAT IN A VAST URBAN WARZONE[/b]

[list]
[*] 9km² Dynamic Map: Strategize across skyscrapers, abandoned factories, and mountain hideouts. Leverage verticality with ziplines for vantage points and paragliders for rapid repositioning.
[*] Shifting Extraction Points: Evacuation zones relocate mid-match! Adapt your exit plan under pressure – high-risk zones yield rare loot.
[/list]


[b]DEEP WEAPON CUSTOMIZATION[/b]

[list]
[*] 30+ Firearms & 100+ Attachments: Tailor weapons for stealth (suppressors, low-zoom scopes) or aggression (extended mags, high-caliber rounds)
[/list]


[b]HIGH-OCTANE MOBILITY & TOOLS[/b]

[list]
[*] Vertical Domination: Secure vantage points with ziplines, reposition rapidly via paragliders, and breach enemy lines by piloting helicopters or off-road vehicles.
[*] Tactical Gear: Call airstrikes to clear hostile zones or clutch-heal teammates with medkits – adapt to every scenario.
[/list]


[b]PVPVE CHAOS[/b]

[list]
[*] Dynamic Squad Play: Team up with 2 allies, revive fallen players, or recruit randoms mid-raid – loyalty is optional when loot is at stake.
[*] Elite Boss Raids: Hunt 10+ faction leaders with unique abilities (e.g., toxin-wielding chemists, shield-bearing enforcers) for gear and cosmetics.
[/list]


JOIN THE COMMUNITY

🔹 Discord: Coordinate with other players → https://discord.gg/zCaH4CKdmP

🔹 Feedback: Report issues via Steam Community or email → steam-cs@shadows.city


Thank you for your support of the game!
Okami Studio

notes.title: “OUTLAWED” Technical Test is Coming Soon!
notes.content:

The “OUTLAWED” Technical Test will officially begin on [b]February 13, 2024, at 7:00 PM EST[/b] (North America Eastern Time)!

[b]Want to be among the first to experience the game and help us improve it?[/b]

Head over to the “OUTLAWED” Steam Store page now and click the [b]"Request Access"[/b] button for a chance to participate in this technical test!

Please Note:
[list]
[*] This is a [b]technical test[/b], and the game is still in development. You may encounter [b]bugs, performance issues, and incomplete content[/b].
[*] During the test, we may make adjustments to the game based on feedback and will [b]perform regular updates and maintenance[/b].
[*] The end date of the test will be announced later, so please stay tuned for official updates.
[/list]

[b]Your participation is invaluable to us![/b]

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions during the test, feel free to reach out to us through the following channels:
[list]
[*] Discord: https://discord.gg/zCaH4CKdmP
[*] Support Email: steam-cs@shadows.city
[/list]

Thank you for your support and interest in “OUTLAWED”. We look forward to seeing you in the game!
[b]Okami Studio[/b]
